threat_event: Tenant isolation defect exposes one customer's patient data to another customer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared database schema with tenant filters enforced in application code
treatment_plan: Row-level security in the database; tenant isolation tests in every release

threat_event: Generative summaries omit or invent clinical facts that care teams rely on
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No systematic accuracy measurement after launch
regulatory_driver: N51-R01 (FTC Act Sec. 5 claims); customer contracts
existing_controls: Summaries labeled as AI-generated; source links
treatment_plan: Monthly accuracy sampling; customer-facing performance statement (P10)

threat_event: AI feature sends customer PHI to a new subcontractor without updated system description or customer BAAs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feature launched 2026-04-15 without change review against SOC 2 commitments or BAAs
affected_asset_or_process: Care summary assist feature; SOC 2 report
existing_controls: Subcontractor BAA with zero data retention
treatment_plan: Update system description; customer notice and BAA amendment; product change gate (P09, P10)

threat_event: Customer breach notices sent after BAA deadlines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: BAA deadlines vary (72 hours for 42 customers); matrix not exercised
treatment_plan: Customer notice register by BAA term; exercise (P08)

threat_event: Build pipeline compromise inserts malicious code into a SaaS release
treatment_plan: Short-lived pipeline credentials; build provenance attestations

threat_event: Prompt injection in a patient document makes the summary disclose other content
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No input filtering for instructions embedded in documents
existing_controls: Summaries limited to one patient context
treatment_plan: Input screening and output checks; red-team test

threat_event: Model provider retains or uses PHI contrary to zero-retention terms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Retention terms contractual only; no attestation received
treatment_plan: Obtain the provider's assurance report; annual attestation

threat_event: Identifiable customer PHI lands in a Group Data Platform staging area meant for de-identified data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: De-identification runs after landing; staging not access-restricted
treatment_plan: De-identify before export from SaaS; restrict staging (group plan GR-01)

threat_event: De-identification for product analytics is not permitted by 97 older customer BAAs
existing_controls: Analytics excludes customers flagged by legal
treatment_plan: Amend BAAs at renewal; exclude until amended

threat_event: Provider B region outage exceeds SaaS availability commitments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Warm standby region; failover tested annually

threat_event: Customer administrator account takeover where customers do not use SSO or MFA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA is a customer configuration choice (complementary user entity control)
treatment_plan: Make MFA default-on for all new tenants and administrator roles

threat_event: Customer integration API keys leaked in public code
Engineer uses standing production access to browse customer PHI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Break-glass access time-bound through group PAM
treatment_plan: Accepted: PAM controls reduce residual to Low

threat_event: Vulnerable open-source dependency exploited in SaaS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Scanning in pipeline; patch SLAs met 94%

threat_event: Departed customer's data retained beyond contract end
Support staff open customer records without a linked ticket
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Support tool allows record search without a ticket reference
treatment_plan: Require ticket linkage for customer record access

threat_event: Vendor or contractor agreement gives a country of concern access to bulk health data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor due diligence does not screen for covered persons under 28 CFR Part 202
existing_controls: No offshore data access permitted by standard terms
treatment_plan: Add covered-person screening to vendor onboarding

threat_event: Marketing claims about AI accuracy or security are not substantiated
treatment_plan: Security and AI claims require product security sign-off
